content: htmx anti-patterns: (1) optimistic UI — updates fall out of sync when the response lands, showing mismatched values, especially when mixed with Alpine; htmx has no rollback so the UI can lie; (2) unthrottled triggers (keyup with no delay) flooding the server and racing responses out of order; (3) swapping large containers / the whole page on every action, which loses scroll position and collapses expanded state; (4) toast systems built on HX-Trigger, which introduce a new JS component and do not degrade without JS — OOB swap of a server-rendered alert region achieves the same with zero script.
